articles.title: Scottish roundup: Miovski hits last-gasp Rangers winner and Celtic keep 100% record
articles.summary: Rangers beat St Mirren 1-0 at Ibrox. Celtic also narrow winners at St Johnstone. A dramatic last-gasp strike from substitute Bojan Miovski gave Rangers a 1-0 Premiership win over St Mirren at Ibrox.
body: Back in the technical area after a two-game touchline suspension, Derek McInnes watched St Mirren’s Australian goalkeeper Jacob Chapman keep the home side at bay in the first half with a string of saves, albeit helped by some poor finishing.

Craig McLeish’s side, who lost 5-1 at Ibrox in the Premier Sports Cup last month, grew in confidence after the break and Fraser Taylor missed a great chance while the frustrated home support returned to the state of agitation which characterised the start of the season.
However, in the final seconds of normal time, Miovski, on for Djeidi Gassama, pounced in the box to grab the winner to make it four victories in a row.
Summer signing Mika Baur notched his first goal for Celtic as the Scottish champions maintained their perfect start to their title defence with a 1-0 victory away to St Johnstone.

articles.title: Cole Palmer powers Chelsea to comeback win against Leeds in nine-goal epic
articles.summary: Where’s the fun in doing it the easy way? Chelsea remain chaotic and this almost went down as Xabi Alonso’s first misjudgment since taking over. The Carabao Cup matters for Chelsea given their lack of European football, but Alonso rotated too much and escaped it after a quadruple half-time…
body: Leeds appeared to be going through after going 2-0 up thanks to goals from Tarik Muharemovic and Brenden Aaronson. Instead they exited in the third round for the 14th time in 18 years after Alonso’s changes paid off. Cole Palmer was inspirational alongside Morgan Rogers and Pedro Neto as Chelsea scored four times in 12 minutes before winning 6-3.

Alonso gambled. Chelsea do not have a taxing schedule but they experimented by making nine changes after losing to Arsenal, struggled to build their patterns during the early stages and were in trouble when Leeds went ahead in the 23rd minute.

In fairness Daniel Farke also took the opportunity to look at his squad players. Leeds made eight changes but playing with greater cohesiveness and commitment gave them the edge during the first half. Chelsea, playing in random bursts, struggled with the intensity and were easily rattled. Reggie Watson, son of Wigan Athletic’s FA Cup hero Ben Watson, made his debut alongside Valentín Barco in midfield at the age of 16 and at least tried to stand up to Leeds.

articles.summary: It was the time and place for Alexis Mac Allister to do his talking on the pitch and the disgruntled Liverpool midfielder did not disappoint. “Very sad” over Liverpool’s refusal to offer him a contract extension, while Dominik Szoboszlai and Ryan Gravenberch were getting theirs, Mac Allister made…
body: The Argentina international, one of five World Cup finalists involved in a finely-poised, absorbing contest, vented his frustration in the best possible way with an immaculate 20-yard strike that extended Diego Simeone’s winless sequence against English opposition in the Champions League group phase to 11 matches. Mac Allister’s moment also gave Andoni Iraola the perfect start to life in the Champions League, and there were several contributions for the Liverpool head coach to savour. From Alexander Isak’s relentless pressing to Florian Wirtz’s consistent creativity, Liverpool rose to one of their toughest tests of the competition.

articles.title: Ødegaard stuns Napoli as Arsenal make winning start in Champions League
articles.summary: After their record-breaking feats last year in the Champions League, Arsenal are at it again. But having been delayed along with hundreds of travelling supporters by travel chaos on Tuesday, Mikel Arteta’s side had to bide their time against Napoli until Martin Ødegaard continued his rich vein of…
body: Perhaps it was the fact they were forced to wear red shorts for the first time since a Premier League game against Watford in 2022 due to Uefa’s insistence that Arsenal were not quite at their flowing best here. Yet they were deserved winners in the end and the substitute, Noni Madueke, should have made the victory more comprehensive in the dying moments as Napoli chased the game. Having come so close to breaking their duck in this competition last year after becoming the first team to win all eight of their group stage matches, Arsenal look equipped to go all the way again if Ødegaard can keep up this sparkling form.

Arteta has bad memories of this stadium after being sent off in a 2-0 defeat during the Champions League group stage in 2013. But Arsenal’s most recent match here ended in victory as they reached the Europa League semi-finals under Unai Emery in 2019. Both clubs have been crowned domestic champions since then, with Napoli ending their 33 year wait in 2023. Yet Champions League success has continued to elude them. They finished third from bottom in the group stage last season.

articles.title: Yankees Fans Will Love Aaron Judge's Reaction To Clinching 34th Straight Winning Season
articles.summary: The New York Yankees beat the Colorado Rockies on Tuesday, securing another winning season. This year is the Yankees' 34th consecutive season with a winning record, making it the second-longest streak among the four major United States professional sports leagues.
body: Consistently finishing with a winning record simply means that the team is giving itself a chance at the postseason every year, but Aaron Judge, who made his much-anticipated return on Tuesday, knows the team has bigger goals.
"We're the Yankees, we're gonna win," Judge said after Tuesday's game. "That's a great streak, but everybody in this room is worried about championships."

articles.title: (Video): PSG slam in 6; Ferran triple and youngster plays a full 90 in the Champions League
articles.summary: Ferran Torres netted three as PSG blew away Slovan Bratislava on matchday one of the Champions League in a much needed win. If you enjoy PSG Talk coverage and want to see more of it, add us as a preferred source on Google to make us a favourite and see more of our content.
body: PSG were desperate for a win in the Champions League tonight as a cure for their winless start in Ligue 1. Not only did they get a win – they got a six goal haul that will have them going into this weekend feeling a lot better about themselves.
Ferran Torres scored on his debut for his new club, and tonight he added three more. The Spaniard looks the perfect Goncalo Ramos replacement up front, with speed, movement and a deadly eye for goal.

As well as three for Torres, there was a double for Ousmane Dembele and a late cap from Fabian Ruiz. Yaya Toure 's Slovan stood no chance as Luis Enrique's team went full throttle right from the start.

Khvicha Kvaratskhelia didn't even have to come onto the pitch in this game, while youngster Dro Fernandez, signed last year from Barcelona, played a full 90. The Parisians racked up a massive 4.71 xG on their way to a comfortable win.

articles.title: Stanley Cup makes sweet stop at iconic Connecticut donut shop in Wallingford
articles.summary: The Stanley Cup trophy returned to Connecticut on Tuesday morning, taking part in a popular early-morning New Haven County ritual. Wallingford native Patrick Budds worked as an assistant equipment manager for the Carolina Hurricanes last season, when they reeled off three straight victories to…
body: The business posted photos on social media Wednesday of Budds and owner Neil Bukowski holding the Stanley Cup together and filling the trophy's top bowl with several of the store's doughnuts.

Carolina's only previous NHL title came during the 2006 season, less than a decade after the franchise's controversial relocation from Hartford. Fittingly, the team's success this past season has given the Stanley Cup plenty of face time in Connecticut. Dunkin' Park hosted a public display of the trophy last month, and Hurricanes defenseman Shayne Gostisbehere hosted a private celebration with the Cup at Dockside Brewery in Milford in July.

Last summer, Newtown native Mackie Samoskevich returned to Connecticut for his day with the Cup after winning with the Florida Panthers. His homecoming tour included stops at the Sandy Hook Permanent Memorial - Samoskevich attended Sandy Hook Elementary School - and his childhood hockey rink.

articles.title: Chelsea hit SIX second-half goals to see off Leeds in Carabao Cup classic
articles.summary: An incredible second-half comeback including six goals in 41 minutes saw Chelsea finally blow away Leeds 6-3 in one of the all-time Carabao Cup classics at Stamford Bridge.
body: The Blues found themselves two goals behind when Brendon Aaronson struck after 47 minutes to add to Tarik Muharemovic's opener and it appeared Xabi Alonso's first real cup test would end in disappointment - despite the half-time introduction of Cole Palmer, Morgan Rogers, Pedro Neto and Reece James.

But a Rogers-inspired comeback, with the England winger making four of their six subsequent goals, saw Chelsea net three times in seven minutes to lead before Danny Welbeck added a fourth to give them breathing space by firing through Michael Zetterer's legs.

Not for the first time in Alonso's short reign however, chaos once again reigned over control as Leeds continued to create chances before Dominic Calvert-Lewin pulled them back to within a goal with 15 minutes to go.

It was still uncertain that Chelsea had finally sealed their progress when Barco blasted them 5-3 up from close range from another Rogers assist, but they could finally rest easy in added time - and extinguish Leeds' commendable never-say-die attitude - when Welbeck nodded Barco's wildly mishit effort beyond Zetterer.

articles.title: Shohei Ohtani Sidelined Again as Dodgers Injury Concerns Mount
articles.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers are sitting Shohei Ohtani after manager Dave Roberts said he would be returning. Ohtani is dealing with knee, biceps, and neck injuries, all of which have come from wear and tear from two-way play.
body: The Japanese star missed Tuesday, September 8th’s game after returning Monday from four straight days off, last Thursday through Sunday.
In total, Ohtani has now missed six of his last seven games, with the hope of getting him healthy again.
“Ohtani came out of yesterday well, but talking to training staff, it’s more of the thought of, ‘Let’s build him up slowly,’” Roberts told the media, including Dodgers Nation.

“For us, it’s not about just tonight. It’s about, ‘What can we do to get him to be optimal as we get into the postseason?’ So I think that a day here or there is not the worst thing to make sure that his body overall feels as close to 100 percent as possible.”

articles.title: Gauff to face new world No 1 Rybakina in semis after incredible comeback
articles.summary: Coco Gauff saved two match points on her way to a three-set victory over teenage French Open winner Mirra Andreeva which set up a semi-final showdown with newly-crowned world No 1 Elena Rybakina.
body: It was a horrible start for 2023 champion Gauff, whose serve and forehand deserted her as she lost the first set in just 26 minutes, hitting only three winners and making 14 unforced errors.
She improved in the second which culminated in a tie-break, during which Russian fifth seed Andreeva squandered two chances to take the match.
That broke Andreeva's spirit and she risked being defaulted after hurling her racket towards her chair, inadvertently sending it spinning towards a camera operator who had to dodge out of the way.
Gauff eventually won 2-6 7-6 (7) 6-2 and revealed she took inspiration from a fellow American's comeback on Tuesday.

articles.title: Mac Allister wins it for Liverpool against Atletico on Barcola's eventful full debut
articles.summary: Alexis Mac Allister's superb strike saw Liverpool come from behind to beat Atletico Madrid 2-1 at Anfield as Bradley Barcola went off with "cramp" on an eventful home debut.
body: Barcola was making his first start for Liverpool but felt his calf in the second half and the £123m signing was substituted having missed three good chances to mark the occasion with a goal. It did not impact the result thanks to Mac Allister's rocket.

Marcos Llorente had opened the scoring for the Spanish side with his fifth goal against Liverpool when put through well by Julian Alvarez on the Argentine forward's return to the starting line-up. But that man Dominik Szoboszlai levelled it up before the break.

Curiously, both Liverpool goals came in the immediate aftermath of Barcola chances. Jan Oblak saved to deny him in the build-up to Szoboszlai's goal, Ronald Araujo cleverly recycling the chance. And Mac Allister blasted in to spare his blushes for the second.

Liverpool had drawn their first two Premier League games of the season two apiece, and given the open nature of the game there was a risk of a repeat. But instead Andoni Iraola earned this Anfield victory in his first Champions League match as a head coach.
